_about: Environment node enclosure (Robotics Lab) - one box, every sensor visible (owner 2026-10-24). Same rules as the door box: clearance fits = part + 0.3 (owner + printer operator, Elegoo Neptune 4); heat-set insert holes and self-tap pilots stay undersize on purpose. Built by build.ps1 with door_enclosure/Build.cs + EnvParts.cs.

env_body._status: 45-degree front corners, 32 mm: each corner face is 45 mm wide, room for the 32.5 x 24.06 HC-SR501 board. Front panel = 190 - 2 x 32 = 126 wide.

pir._status: HC-SR501 x2, MEASURED board 32.5 x 24.06, ~25 high (owner). DATASHEET (Electrokit): lens D23 -> hole 23.3 (0.3 rule); 2 x M2 holes 28 apart -> M2 self-tap pilots 1.6 (undersize on purpose). Boss 1.0 high for the lens base under the board = ESTIMATE (add a washer if the board rocks). PIR 1 = left corner (zone 1), PIR 2 = right corner (zone 2): together ~200 degrees.

mq._status: Flying-Fish / 'MH MQ Sensor' module (owner photos 2026-10-24): can on the FRONT, trimmer + LM393 + 4-pin header (in-plane, at the bottom end) on the BACK -> board flush on the panel's rear, can out through 19.81 (19.51 + 0.3). MEASURED board 20.2 x 32.22 -> 20.5 x 32.52 between the rails. Can centre 11.8 below the board's top end = PHOTO ESTIMATE. Ties press the board flat (slots 1..7 mm behind the panel). Type MQ-2 CONFIRMED (owner read it on the sensor, 2026-10-24).

dht._status: DHT22 module, MEASURED (owner) 15.5 x 37.8 -> pocket 15.8 x 38.1; window 1 mm smaller all round keeps it in, grille faces the room; walls left / right / top + its own PCB at the back keep the box's warm air off it; pins at the bottom end. OWNER PHOTO: white grille body on the front, 3 pins at the bottom end (open end of the pocket) - matches.

flame._status: OWNER PHOTOS 2026-10-24: round board D39.75 (caliper) -> pocket 40.05 (+0.3), 1 mm deep in the 3 mm top wall; 5 receivers on the front edge fan out over the front (tips ~7 mm past the panel); the blue multi-turn trimmer (~10 high) in the CENTRE -> the board lies on the TOP of the box, fully outside, trimmer reachable. 12-pin header at the back edge: wires drop through a 34 x 8 slot behind it (12 x 2.54 = 30.5 + room; >= 2.78 rule). Two zip ties over the back half through 3 x 4 slots.

usb_access._status: ESP32 flat on the plate, lower left, USB-C end toward the left wall (40 mm in: push the cable through, then plug).

dc_in._status: 12 V in: M16 gland 16.0 + 0.3, in the left wall so the bottom stays flat for a desk

electronics_plate._fit: 2026-10-24: plate 190 - 2 x 39 = 112 wide so it goes in through the front opening (117.5 between the 45-degree corner walls); 162 did not fit. Modules in 2 rows inside |x| < 57 - the corners behind the PIRs stay empty.
